blocks.html: All spaces between fireplaces and floors and ceilings through which fireplaces pass shall be fire-blocked with approved noncombustible material securely fastened in place. The fire-blocking of spaces between wood joists, beams or headers shall be to a depth of 1 inch (25 mm) and shall only be placed on strips of metal or metal lath laid across the spaces between combustible material and the chimney.
